name: Open-Meteo (service)
description: Non-placeable data source that exposes the Open-Meteo API (no key required) for a code element: current conditions, hourly + daily forecast, air quality, and marine. Not shown in the canvas picker; source it from a code/data element by its key 'openmeteo_service'. Probe with empty options to get a map of scopes + the variables each accepts, then request a scope with a variables list. Latitude/longitude fall back to the app's home location when omitted.

cell_options.name: latitude
cell_options.help: Latitude in decimal degrees. 0 uses the app's home location.
cell_options.label: Latitude

cell_options.name: longitude
cell_options.help: Longitude in decimal degrees. 0 uses the app's home location.
cell_options.label: Longitude

cell_options.name: variables
cell_options.label: Variables
cell_options.help: Separated by commas. Empty uses a sensible default set for the scope.
